assistant.instructions: Album covers from the iTunes Search API (no artist photos — iTunes doesn't serve them). The chain path (POST /v1/images/album with pluginId=itunes) returns one auto-picked cover; search_album_art returns MULTIPLE candidates with album/artist names so a model can pick the right edition.

tools.name: search_album_art
tools.description: Search iTunes for album covers — returns up to `limit` candidates (album + artist + 600x600 url) instead of one auto-pick
